name: Fraimic Large Canvas (31.5")
description: Fraimic's 31.5" Spectra 6 canvas in a 24x36" walnut frame, 1440x2560 hung upright, on battery. Tesserae drives it over the frame's local REST API with no app, cloud or firmware change: it sets the wake schedule, uploads the latest picture at each wake and puts the frame back to sleep.
notes_md:
Confirmed on real hardware: a Large Canvas on firmware 0.2.31 drew frames uploaded to `/api/image`, and woke six times in a row on a chain of wake times four minutes apart. Needs firmware 0.2.31 or later for the wake schedule. See the [Fraimic quickstart](https://docs.tesserae.ink/quickstart/fraimic/).

The code **TESSERAE10** takes 10% off at fraimic.com. Fraimic supplied this frame to Tesserae free of charge, and Tesserae earns a commission on sales made with the code.
